newsitem.title: USA: Kluge buys a mln shrs in Occidental - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Kluge buys a mln shrs in Occidental - WSJ.

text.p: Billionarie John Kluge, a director of Occidental Petroleum Corp, last month bought one million shares of the company for $24 million, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
The report said the purchase makes Kluge one of the largest individual shareholders in the company, which has not kept pace with its rivals, prompting Wall Street to question Kluge's move.
Before the buy Kluge held 20,500 shares of Occidental, the paper said, adding that the purchase represents 0.3 percent of Occidental's outstanding shares.
